title: Mapping the Potential of Explainable AI for Fairness Along the AI Lifecycle

bias_targets.methodology: Retrospective theoretical evaluation using the COMPAS recidivism prediction system as a case study to illustrate how Explainable AI (XAI) can identify, communicate, and mitigate disparities against Black defendants across the AI lifecycle.
Conceptual discussion analyzing how data-centric XAI explanations can reveal pre-existing disparities (e.g., the gender pay gap) and guide the handling of sensitive demographic features.
